hello.speaker: uncle-bright
hello.text: Eii, another fresher! Akwaaba, akwaaba. Welcome to UCIS.

book.speaker: uncle-bright
book.text: Before you enter, you sign the book. Everybody signs. Name?

choices.text: Do I really have to sign? I have my admission letter.

manners.speaker: uncle-bright
manners.text: Ah, see manners! Somebody trained you well. And your programme?

letter.speaker: uncle-bright
letter.text: Letter or no letter, everybody signs. Even the Vice-Chancellor signs. …Well, his driver signs. Programme?

programme.speaker: uncle-bright
programme.text: {programme}, hmm? Then you need your student ID. Go to the Administration Block, north of the courtyard. Without it, the gate doesn't know you.

sign.speaker: uncle-bright
sign.text: And read the big sign by the road. Everybody walks past it; nobody reads it. Go well!
